title: Parameterized level-18 target gauge-image quotient basis

report.result: The seventy-seven exact checkpoint maps form a typed 439,904-dimensional direct sum of certified irreducible incidence blocks. Exact six-parameter specialization and quotient APIs are executable.
report.boundary: This is an exact quotient on the direct sum of certified source-target incidence blocks. The checkpoints do not determine how a convention-fixed physical K routes its six channel coefficients into those blocks, nor do the cited sources fix those coefficients. The supplied generic and special routings are synthetic controls. No physical target gauge quotient is claimed.
